purpose: One module (a duration parser and formatter) to write from a README of thirteen interacting rules: unit order, a zero exception, a fraction only on the last component and only on whole seconds, a whole-text sign, an ISO 8601 form that inherits the number rules, and ASCII-only digits. Visible tests cover only the plain cases; the rule tests are hidden. Built after no unreviewed run missed a spec-edges or spec-conventions rule, to ask whether rule density leaves a review something to catch.
